patch_description: Replace the collective (shared) input RY with per-qubit independent RY rotations (8 params instead of 1). This breaks qubit symmetry at the input, allowing each qubit to learn a feature-specific rotation angle since different qubits see different IsingZZ feature encodings. Keep collective RZ, collective output RY and RX to maintain regularization. This increases from 4 to 11 unique params per block (68 total), a moderate increase that should improve accuracy while keeping generalization gap small.
